newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO finds Dfl 100 mln cost savings.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO finds Dfl 100 mln cost savings.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO Holding NV said it had achieved annual cost savings of 100 million guilders through a reorganisation of its head office.
The bank said in a information bulletin to staff that the savings were achieved in a 10-stage project which lasted 18 months.
"A total improvement of about 100 million guilders is something which justifies satisfaction," the bank said.
ABN AMRO said savings came through out-sourcing services such as providing furniture and office equipment, catering, training, building maintenance and automation of processes.
Head office staff were asked to find ways of improving the effectiveness and efficiency of their departments.
The bank said the financial benefits of other measures to improve quality and output could not be quantified but they were also valuable.
The reorganisation did not involve forced redundancies.
